caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate sofa positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The sofa has a dark brown wooden frame with detailed carvings, particularly a prominent decorative carving at the top center of the backrest. The upholstery is a yellow-gold color with a floral pattern consisting of swirling vines and small pink flowers. The sofa has a triple-arched backrest, which curves downward between each arch, and the arms are slightly flared outward. The seat and inside of the arms are upholstered with the same patterned fabric as the backrest. The legs of the sofa are short and robust, with rounded feet. There are no additional objects in the image.
title: Mahogany Sofa
